The issuer is highly leveraged (shareholders’ equity is only ~3.4% of total assets) and profitability is negative (net income -$1,088M and EBIT/operating income -$780M), indicating weak debt-service capacity. While liquidity looks somewhat supported (current ratio ~1.78), the combination of losses and very thin equity points to elevated credit risk consistent with a CCC rating.

DECISION: CCC
